snippet.title: Plushy Store Tidy Up
snippet.description:
Turn a messy plushy store into a cozy little world of perfectly organized cuddly toys!

In Plushy Store Tidy Up, every plushy has a place but figuring out exactly where everything belongs is up to you. Pick up plushies, carry and organize them, solve satisfying shelf puzzles, and gradually restore the entire store.

As you tidy your way through the store, you'll discover new plushies, encounter trickier layouts, unlock new areas, and improve your abilities to make organizing faster and more satisfying.

Wishlist on steam :  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1470810/Plushy_Store_Tidy_Up/
